description: Google 2019 cluster application failure analysis is provided by Research authors. The paper studies failed and killed jobs in the 2019 Google cluster traces, relating them to resource use, scheduling class, priority, job duration and resubmissions across eight clusters. Geographic context: global; eight Google production clusters. Temporal coverage and spatial resolution are not established beyond the source details stated here.
